title: ClaimCoach — A denial specialist on your laptop
audience: Prospective users and Y Combinator reviewers

scenes.title:
A denial specialist
on your laptop.
scenes.narration: A denied claim should not leave an entry-level biller guessing. Claim Coach brings denial-management guidance into Hermes Desktop, with private, local models and a clear path from evidence to a reviewable draft.

scenes.title: Enable ClaimCoach
scenes.narration: Start in Hermes Desktop. Open Capabilities, choose Plugins, rescan, and enable Claim Coach. Open the Claim Coach pane. This is where you create cases and work through each denial.

scenes.title: Connect a model on this Mac
scenes.instruction: Hermes chat → local model server · ClaimCoach → local worker
scenes.narration: Configure Hermes to use a model server on this Mac. The model weights live in your Models folder. Claim Coach has its own local worker, which routes document processing and drafting to local models.

scenes.title: Add the denial evidence
scenes.instruction: Paste 835 text → Attach pasted text → Process case
scenes.narration: Create a case and add the denial letter, an explanation of benefits, or pasted eight thirty-five text. Our example uses fictional data from Northstar Demo Health. Process the case to read its fields.

scenes.title: Check the facts first
scenes.instruction: Review payer, codes, dates and amounts · Confirm unreadable fields
scenes.narration: Review the payer, service dates, amounts, and denial codes. Confirm any fields the software could not read. The example denial concerns authorization. Keep the original evidence beside the structured fields while checking them.

scenes.title: Understand the next step
scenes.instruction: Read the explanation, deadline and missing-document checklist
scenes.narration: Run diagnosis to get a plain-language explanation and a checklist of missing documents. Review the rule card and appeal deadline. These are decision aids: the biller checks the evidence and decides what to do next.
scenes.note: Verify against the payer rule card

scenes.title: Turn evidence into a draft
scenes.instruction: Draft appeal → edit → save → export PDF or DOCX
scenes.narration: Request an appeal draft, or a corrected-claim checklist when that is the right remedy. Edit and save the result, then export it for review. Claim Coach does not send appeals or submit claims.

scenes.title: Ask the Hermes agent
scenes.narration: In Hermes chat, use the denial command with a case identifier. The denial-triage skill guides the agent. Its tools retrieve code explanations, payer rules, and a redacted case summary, without handing over the source documents.

scenes.title: The Hermes loop, made useful
scenes.narration: The Hermes loop reads your request, chooses a tool, inspects the result, and continues. Skills supply the playbook. Commands provide shortcuts. Local models do the inference, while the plugin keeps the case workflow organized.

scenes.title:
Give every biller
a clearer next step.
scenes.narration: Record the final outcome when it is known. Claim Coach turns specialist workflow into practical guidance on a consumer laptop. Private evidence, useful next steps, and a person in control of every final decision.
